setup: Bar on upper traps (high-bar) or rear delts (low-bar)
Feet shoulder-width, toes 10–20° out, screw heels in
execution: Brace — big breath into belly, lock core
Break hips and knees together; descend to at least parallel, drive mid-foot up
mistakes: Knees caving inward — shove knees out over toes
Heels lifting or chest collapsing forward
tips: Heels-elevated stance helps depth for taller lifters or quad emphasis

setup: Bar over mid-foot, shins ~1 inch from bar
Hinge to grip — chest tall, lats tucked, slight knee bend
execution: Pull slack out of bar, then push the floor away with legs
Lock hips at top, don't hyperextend; control the descent
mistakes: Bar drifting forward — keep bar against shins
Lower back rounding under load
tips: Mixed grip or straps above ~80% 1RM; chalk for grip

setup: Upper back on bench, bar over hip crease with pad
Feet planted shin-vertical at top, knees ~90°
execution: Tuck chin and ribs down; only the hips move
Drive through heels, lock glutes at top — pause briefly
mistakes: Lower back arching (cue: posterior pelvic tilt at top)
Heels lifting or feet too far forward (becomes a back lift)
tips: Single-leg variant balances side-to-side strength

setup: Dumbbells at sides, neutral grip; chest up, core braced
Step length: knee tracks over middle of front foot
execution: Step forward into a stride, knee just shy of the floor
Drive through front heel to next step — minimize push-off from rear leg
mistakes: Knee tracking inside the foot
Stepping too short (becomes a quad burn instead of glute stretch)
tips: Slower descent (~2s) emphasizes the loaded stretch for glute growth

setup: Knees aligned with the machine's pivot axis
Back flat against pad, hands relaxed on handles
execution: Extend slowly; squeeze quads hard at lockout
Controlled negative (~2-3s); don't let weight crash down
mistakes: Slamming into lockout (joint stress) or partial reps
Lifting hips off pad to cheat the weight up
tips: Toes-out emphasizes vastus medialis (teardrop); pointed straight is balanced

setup: Knee axis aligned with machine pivot
Thigh pad locked snug; back against pad
execution: Curl heels under glutes; squeeze hamstrings at bottom
Slow eccentric (~2s); don't let stack hit
mistakes: Letting hips lift off pad
Bouncing the weight to start the rep
tips: Pointing toes back (dorsiflexion) reduces calf involvement, isolates hams more

setup: Ball of foot on edge of platform, knees fully extended
Toes pointed straight forward
execution: Press up through big toe — full plantarflexion
Slow drop into deep stretch (~3s); pause briefly at bottom
mistakes: Bouncing out of the stretch (steals tendon energy)
Cutting the range — only mid-range counts least
tips: Stretched-position emphasis (lower) drives more calf growth than top-only reps

setup: Bar across front delts, elbows high
Either clean grip or crossed-arm grip
execution: Stay upright — torso vertical throughout
Drive elbows up out of the hole
mistakes: Elbows dropping (cue: "elbows to ceiling")
Caving forward = quad burn lost, low-back strained
tips: More quad-dominant than back squat; pairs well with low-bar work

setup: Rope between legs, face away from cable
Stagger or hip-width stance, slight knee bend
execution: Hinge at hips — push butt back, rope traces inner thighs
Squeeze glutes hard at top to stand up
mistakes: Squatting the rep — turn it into a hinge
Hyperextending at top (back, not glutes, finishes)
tips: Anterior tilt eccentric, posterior tilt concentric — sequence the pelvis

setup: Foot high on platform; opposite foot off plate
Hips and back firm against pad
execution: Lower until knee approaches chest (deep ROM)
Press through heel — slow eccentric (~2s)
mistakes: Knee caving inward under load
Lifting hips off seat (lower-back rounding)
tips: Higher foot = more hip/glute; lower foot = more quad

setup: Eyes under bar; shoulder blades retracted + depressed, slight arch
Grip ~1.5× shoulder width, feet planted, light leg drive
execution: Lower under control to lower chest, elbows ~45°
Press up and slightly back, lockout over shoulders
mistakes: Elbows flaring to 90° (shoulder strain)
Bouncing the bar off chest or losing scapular set
tips: 1s pause on chest builds bottom-end strength and protects shoulders

setup: Back firmly against pad; bench upright
Dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward, elbows ~45°
execution: Press up overhead — bells nearly touch at top
Lower with control to ear level (deep stretch)
mistakes: Stopping short (top half only)
Arching the lower back to cheat the press
tips: Bench at ~75° (slight incline) is friendlier on shoulders than fully vertical

setup: Bars about shoulder-width; lean torso forward 15–20° (chest emphasis)
Scapulae retracted and depressed throughout
execution: Lower until shoulders just below elbows or chest deep stretch
Drive up — keep lean, don't pop upright
mistakes: Going too deep with shoulders rolling forward (anterior strain)
Vertical torso turns it into a triceps-only movement (fine if intended)
tips: Use a dip belt; band-assisted dips for sub-bodyweight progression

setup: Set pulleys at hip height; one cable each hand
Slight forward lean; arms slightly bent and locked
execution: Sweep hands up and toward each other in an arc
Pause and squeeze at top (hands meet at upper chest level)
mistakes: Bending the elbow more during the rep (becomes a press)
Letting cables pull arms behind body line on stretch
tips: Pec deck is a great regression with the same upper-chest bias

setup: Flat bench; one dumbbell in each hand, neutral grip
Upper arms vertical, slight angle back toward head
execution: Lower bells past ears (deep triceps stretch)
Extend elbows back to lockout — only elbow joint moves
mistakes: Upper arms drifting forward (shifts work off triceps)
Flaring elbows out to the sides
tips: Slight angle (vs perfectly vertical) keeps tension on triceps throughout

setup: Slight torso lean forward (~10°); soft elbow bend (15°)
Dumbbells in front of thighs
execution: Raise out and slightly forward to shoulder height
Pinky slightly up at top (cue: "pour a pitcher")
mistakes: Going above shoulder height (traps take over)
Using momentum/swing instead of strict raise
tips: Hold a small pause at the top; cable variant for constant tension

setup: Kneel with wheel under shoulders; arms straight
Posteriorly tilt pelvis (squeeze glutes) — locked
execution: Roll out as far as you can hold neutral spine
Pull back via abs (not arms)
mistakes: Lower back sagging at extension (cut range short instead)
Pulling with shoulders/arms instead of abs
tips: Build to standing rollouts only after months of solid kneeling reps

setup: Grip shoulder-width; elbows tucked tight to sides
Same scapular set as flat bench
execution: Lower to lower sternum, elbows brushing ribs
Press up keeping elbows in — triceps drive the rep
mistakes: Going too narrow — wrist pain, no extra triceps recruitment
Flaring elbows (defeats the variation)
tips: Pin press or floor press variants overload top-half lockout

setup: Bar in front rack, hands just outside shoulders
Glutes squeezed, ribs down, tight core
execution: Press up — push your head through the bar at lockout
Lock out over mid-foot, not in front
mistakes: Excessive lower-back arch (lumbar hyperextension)
Pushing the bar forward instead of up
tips: Slight push-press for top sets allows heavier overload through sticking point

setup: Bench at 30° (sweet spot for upper-chest emphasis)
Scapulae retracted, dumbbells over lower chest
execution: Lower with elbows ~45° to side of upper chest
Press up; bells meet over upper chest at top
mistakes: Bench too steep (>45°) — becomes shoulder press
Pressing in (clanking bells) loses pec tension
tips: 30° outperforms flat bench for upper-chest growth (Chaves et al. 2020)

setup: Back firm against pad; forearms on pads (or grip handles)
Slight elbow bend, shoulders down
execution: Squeeze elbows together in front of chest
Slow open (~2s) into a deep stretch
mistakes: Shrugging shoulders forward to help close
Bouncing out of the stretch
tips: Stretched-position partials at end of set drive extra pec growth

setup: Cable set low; lean forward, upper arm parallel to torso
Pin elbow tight against side throughout
execution: Extend forearm back; lock out + squeeze 1s
Slow return — never let elbow drift forward
mistakes: Letting elbow swing — only the forearm should move
Using too much weight (loses isolation)
tips: Cable beats dumbbell version — constant tension all the way through ROM

setup: Lie supine; hands lightly behind head (don't pull)
Lower back pressed into floor
execution: Bring opposite elbow to knee; rotate from torso
Slow and controlled — quality > speed
mistakes: Yanking on the neck
Going fast (becomes momentum, not abs)
tips: Pause briefly at full rotation for max oblique recruitment

setup: Dead hang with hands ~shoulder-width, palms forward
Engage scapula down + back before pulling
execution: Pull chest to bar; chin clears it
Lower under control to full hang
mistakes: Kipping or swinging — turns it into a CrossFit move
Stopping at chin (half rep)
tips: Add band assistance for deficits; weighted belt once 10+ bodyweight reps clean

setup: Bar over mid-foot; torso parallel to floor
Overhand grip just outside knees
execution: Explosively row bar to lower chest/upper abs
Reset bar on floor between every rep — dead-stop reps
mistakes: Torso rising during the row (becomes a lat-less power lift)
Pulling to belly button (recruits less upper back)
tips: Classic strict version is brutal upper-back size builder

setup: Cable at face height; rope attachment
Seated, arms straight, chest tall
execution: Pull rope to face — elbows lead, ends of rope split to sides of head
External rotation: thumbs back at end position
mistakes: Pulling to chest (loses rear delt + rotator cuff focus)
Letting shoulders shrug up
tips: Best single exercise for shoulder health + posture; do them often

setup: Cable high, side stance, one arm reaches up to handle
Free hand on hip or stabilizer; soft elbow lock
execution: Pull arm down to side, laterally flex torso into the pull
Squeeze lat at bottom; slow stretch to top
mistakes: Bending elbow (turns into row)
Using shoulder rotation instead of lat
tips: Light isolation warm-up — primes lats for heavier work

setup: Arms over pad, armpits against top edge
Dumbbells with supinated grip; full extension at bottom
execution: Curl up — squeeze biceps hard at top
Slow descent (~3s); short of full elbow lock at bottom
mistakes: Coming off the pad to cheat
Letting elbow extend fully under load (biceps tendon stress)
tips: Single-arm preacher allows full focus on one side per set

setup: EZ bar, pronated grip (palms down); shoulder-width
Elbows pinned at sides
execution: Curl up — squeeze forearms + brachialis at top
Slow eccentric — don't lose wrist position
mistakes: Wrist bending under load (use straight wrists)
Using momentum/body english
tips: Hits brachialis hard — drives upper-arm thickness more than biceps width

setup: EZ bar, supinated grip (palms up); shoulder-width
Elbows tucked tight to sides
execution: Curl up to top — biceps squeeze
Slow descent; full elbow extension at bottom
mistakes: Swinging body to start the rep
Lifting elbows forward (front delts take over)
tips: EZ bar is more wrist-friendly than straight bar with similar gains

setup: Knees locked under pad; lean ~10° back
Neutral handle; grip just outside shoulder width
execution: Pull handle to upper chest; elbows drive down + back
Squeeze lats at bottom; slow stretch at top
mistakes: Excessive lean-back (becomes a row)
Pulling with biceps instead of leading with elbows
tips: Neutral grip is most shoulder-friendly and great for lat thickness

setup: Tall seated, knees slightly bent, chest tall
Lats engaged before you pull (depress shoulders)
execution: Pull handle to lower sternum; elbows tuck along ribs
Squeeze 1s; slow return to full lat stretch
mistakes: Rocking the torso forward/back (lower-back swing)
Letting shoulders round forward at stretch
tips: Wide grip + elbows out hits rear delts/upper back; close + tucked hits lats

setup: Cable high; kneel facing the machine
Torso lean forward ~30-45°; arms locked
execution: Pull rope/bar down to thighs in an arc
Squeeze lats hard; slow return overhead
mistakes: Bending elbows mid-rep — turns it into pressdown
Pulling with traps/biceps instead of lats
tips: Best lat-isolation move there is; perfect lat finisher

setup: Grip ~1.5× shoulder width, bar at hip
Brace core, slight knee bend
execution: Shrug up and slightly back — drive traps to ears
Pause 1s top; slow descent
mistakes: Rolling shoulders (no traps benefit, just shoulder strain)
Using too much weight + short range
tips: Wider grip hits upper traps more than standard shrug grip

setup: Cables crossed in front; opposite-side handle each hand
Slight forward lean; soft elbow bend
execution: Sweep arms out and back; squeeze rear delts hard
Slow return — don't let cables drag arms forward
mistakes: Using too much weight (back muscles take over)
Bending elbows mid-rep (becomes a row)
tips: Light weight, high reps (15-20+) works best for rear delts

setup: Stand sideways to machine, cable low
Elbow behind torso for full peak contraction
execution: Curl with strict elbow position
Squeeze top 1s; slow descent
mistakes: Letting elbow drift forward as you curl
Lifting shoulder to cheat the weight
tips: Constant tension makes cable curls great for short-head biceps peak

setup: Dumbbells neutral grip (thumbs up), arms at sides
Elbows pinned
execution: Curl up keeping wrists neutral throughout
Slow eccentric to full stretch
mistakes: Rotating wrists during rep
Swinging or using torso momentum
tips: Hits brachialis + brachioradialis — adds arm thickness traditional curls miss

setup: Upper back deliberately rounded (yes — for glute focus)
Dumbbell held at chest; pad just above hip crease
execution: Drive hips into pad like a hip thrust; flex spine at top
Slow descent into a deep glute stretch
mistakes: Treating it like a back extension (long lever, lower back loaded)
Going to vertical too fast — kill the bottom stretch
tips: Different from "stiff back" hypers — this one is glute-biased

setup: Band just above knees or around ankles
Quarter-squat: knees soft, hips back
execution: Step sideways with the leading leg — band stays tense
Trailing leg follows; never relaxed band
mistakes: Standing too upright (kills glute medius tension)
Knees collapsing inward as you step
tips: Use as a glute med activation primer before squat/deadlift

setup: Start: dumbbells in front, palms toward face, elbows tucked
Seated, back supported
execution: Rotate palms out as you press up — finish overhead
Reverse the rotation on the way down
mistakes: Rotating before pressing (loses tension)
Lowering only to shoulder height (missing stretch)
tips: Adds front-delt + rotator cuff activation vs straight DB press

setup: Face away from cable; rope behind head
Upper arms close to head, elbows pointing forward
execution: Extend rope up and out at lockout
Slow stretch back behind head — feel the long head
mistakes: Letting elbows flare to the sides
Stopping short of full stretch (the whole point of overhead)
tips: Long head of triceps gets best growth stimulus from stretched positions

setup: Hang from bar with full grip; slight shoulder engagement
Posteriorly tilt pelvis to start (this is the cue)
execution: Curl knees (regression) or straight legs (full) up to bar height
Lower slowly — don't just drop
mistakes: Swinging — uses momentum, not abs
Leg raise only (no pelvic tilt) — that's hip flexor work, not abs
tips: Toes-to-bar is the full version; knee tucks first if straight legs too hard

setup: Knee + opposite hand on bench; back flat
Dumbbell hangs straight down, weak-side foot grounded
execution: Row elbow up and back along ribs
Squeeze lat at top; slow descent into full stretch
mistakes: Torso rotation to cheat the weight up
Pulling with the arm instead of leading with the elbow
tips: Slight stretch at bottom (let dumbbell pull shoulder forward) drives lat growth

setup: Chest pad firmly supported; feet planted
Neutral grip (or wide); band attached for extra tension top
execution: Row toward upper abs; squeeze upper back at top
Slow eccentric — fight the band on the way down
mistakes: Lifting chest off the pad (loses isolation)
Pulling with hands instead of driving elbows back
tips: Band adds end-range overload — most rows have least tension at peak

setup: Cable low; rope attachment, hands shoulder-width
Stand close to machine; tall posture
execution: Pull rope up and out — elbows lead, hands flare apart
Stop at chest height (no higher) — squeeze top
mistakes: Going above chest height (shoulder impingement risk)
Pulling with biceps instead of side delts
tips: Wide grip + low pull = side delt/upper trap focus; safer than barbell variant

setup: Lie chest-down on incline bench (~45°)
Arms hang straight; supinated grip on bar or DBs
execution: Curl up — only the forearm moves (elbows perpendicular to floor)
Squeeze hard at top; slow eccentric to full stretch
mistakes: Letting elbows swing back to cheat
Coming off the bench
tips: Eliminates body english — pure biceps stimulus

setup: Stand tall with bar at hip crease, slight knee bend (≈15°)
Lats engaged, shoulders over bar
execution: Push hips back (hinge) — keep bar against thighs
Descend until you feel hamstring stretch (~mid-shin), drive hips forward
mistakes: Squatting instead of hinging — knees stay nearly static
Rounding the lower back at bottom
tips: Stop where flexibility ends; don't chase floor depth

setup: Stand close to stack; elbows pinned at sides
Slight forward lean; engage core
execution: Press down to full extension; squeeze 1s
Control return to ~90° at elbow
mistakes: Elbows flaring out or drifting forward
Leaning over the bar (using body weight = cheat)
tips: Rope attachment + separating hands at lockout = extra long-head emphasis

setup: Forearms shoulder-width; elbows under shoulders
Body in straight line: head, hips, heels aligned
execution: Squeeze glutes + quads to lock pelvis neutral
Hold while breathing — don't hold breath
mistakes: Hips sagging (lower back stressed) or hips piking up
Holding longer past form failure
tips: 30-60s of tight plank beats 3-minutes of sloppy hold; weighted variants for progression

setup: Hold dumbbell at chest, elbows tucked in
Stance slightly wider than shoulder-width, toes out
execution: Sit down between the heels; chest up
Drive knees out, stand tall
mistakes: Letting elbows drift forward (counterweight lost)
Heels coming up
tips: Pause 2-3s at bottom for mobility + control

setup: Knees just past edge of pad, hips pressed down
Pad sits on Achilles, not calves
execution: Curl heels to glutes; brief squeeze at top
Control the descent (~2s)
mistakes: Lifting hips off pad — defeats hamstring isolation
Half-range reps (only top or bottom)
tips: Single-leg variant evens out side-to-side imbalances
